newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish Bank Pekao to lend power plant DM 85.4 mln.
newsitem.headline: Polish Bank Pekao to lend power plant DM 85.4 mln.

text.p: Polish state-owned Bank Pekao SA has signed an agreement to organise a consortium to lend power station Dolna Odra SA 85.4 million marks, the bank said in a statement on Tuesday.
Pekao, which will be the agent for the loan, said the funds would go toward building desulphurisation facilities.

It said state-owned Bank Handlowy SA would take part in the loan, as would Pekao's Tel Aviv unit and two banks in its capital group, Bank Depozytowo-Kredytowy SA (BDK) and Pomorski Bank Kredytowy w Szczecinie SA (PBKS).
Last year Pekao lent Dolna Odra 35 million zlotys to help finance its modernisation and organised a consortium lending another 98.5 million zlotys.
The Pekao group's privatisation is due next year.
